description: Phase 3: deletes the selected elements and relationships as ONE expanded cascade - view connections, view nodes, relationships, then elements DESCENDANTS-FIRST, so the engine's still_referenced / still_has_children checks pass without ever cascading silently (decision Q3: the caller expands). The removed DTOs (elements with their source triple, tags, governance and property kinds, the relationships and the view placement) are deep-copied before the first execution, so Undo restores exactly the state the user deleted in one step.
